<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0022026-09-0702-01-33" status="unreviewed"> 
      <milestone unit="section" n="i.2) lhan cig dmigs pa sgrub par mi nus"/>
       <lb n="17.10"/> lhan cig dmigs pa nges pa'i rtags kyis snang ba sems su bsgrub par mi nus pa ni 
        
        <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3831">phya pa</rs> na re gang zhig ma yin dgag gi khyab bya khyab byed yin kyang 'brel ba med na ci sto ste khyab pa ma grub bo || 'di ltar bu ram gyi ro mngar po dang kha dog smug po gnyis ma yin dgag gi khyab bya khyab byed yin kyang | de gnyis dus mnyam pas de las byung ba'i 'brel ba ma yin par thal | skye mched kyi rdzas tha dad pas bdag gcig pa'i 'brel ba med par mthong ngo zhes zer te |
          shes pa las tha dad pa'i bu ram gyi ro dang kha dog nyid <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference">kho bo cag</rs> sems tsam pa la ma grub bo zhes zer na lan dka' 'o zhes <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3864">byang skyabs</rs> gsung ngo ||</seg></TEI>
